title: Reflected / stored XSS
summary: Prove untrusted input executes in HTML/JS contexts in a victim browser.
steps: Inject a unique canary into search/reflect params from the map.
Confirm reflection context (HTML body, quoted attribute, JavaScript string) and encoding via response or browser; reflection alone is not execution.

Choose one context-matched, nonce-backed browser execution proof in-scope; an event handler is suitable for HTML body or DOM insertion, while a quoted JavaScript string needs a matching string-breakout probe.
If filtered, try one context-appropriate encoding — do not spray huge payload lists.
Stored: submit canary, reload as second identity if available.
On PASS: fresh nonce-backed script execution in the scoped browser with a reproducible URL; reflection or raw markup alone is only a lead.
pass_signals: Fresh nonce appears in a browser dialog from the scoped origin
kill_signals: Output encoded and CSP blocks with no viable bypass after context tests
references: PortSwigger: Find XSS / Reflected XSS / Stored XSS
